login.title: Welcome back
login.nothingOffered: This server offers no way to sign in from this browser. Ask whoever runs it for help.
login.passkeyCancelled: You cancelled, or the prompt timed out.
login.passkeyFailed: That didn't work. Try again, or sign in another way.
login.passkeyRelaySubtitle: The app sent you here so this browser can ask for your passkey. You'll be sent straight back.
login.passkeyReturnToApp: You're signed in. Go back to the app — this tab can be closed.
login.defaultError: Unable to log in. Check your credentials.

register.subtitleBootstrap: No users exist yet. This account will become the workspace super user.
register.defaultError: Unable to register. Try a different email.
register.verifyEmailMessage: Thanks! Check your inbox to verify your email before signing in.
register.pendingApproval: Thanks! Your account is waiting for approval from whoever runs this server.
register.unableToLoadInvite: Unable to load invite details right now.
register.numberLocked: Your number is picked for you and stays with your account.
register.numberLockedWith: Your number is #{{number}}. It's picked for you and stays with your account.
register.recoveryCodesNote: Your account has no password, so these codes are how you'll set one later. Save them somewhere safe, because we only show them once.
register.noDoorHere: This deployment does not take new accounts directly. Sign in with your organization's provider instead.

inviteRequired.title: Invite required
inviteRequired.subtitle: Public registration is not available. Please ask an existing member for an invite link to join.

passwordsOff.title: Password sign-in is off
passwordsOff.description: This server doesn't sign anyone in with a password, so there is nothing to reset. Sign in another way.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email tied to your account. We'll send a reset link if it exists.
forgotPassword.sent: If that account exists, a reset link is on its way to your inbox.
forgotPassword.error: Unable to send reset email. Try again later.
forgotPassword.useRecoveryCode: No password to reset? Use a recovery code
forgotPassword.recoverSubtitle: Enter one of your recovery codes to set a password. You'll sign in with it afterwards.
forgotPassword.recovered: Your password is set. Sign in with it now.
forgotPassword.recoverError: Couldn't set a password. Check the address and the code, then try again.
forgotPassword.backToReset: Send me a reset link instead

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitleInvalid: This link is invalid. Request a new one.
resetPassword.missingToken: Reset link is missing. Use the email link again.
resetPassword.error: Unable to reset password. The link may have expired.

verifyEmail.title: Email verification
verifyEmail.success: Email verified! You can sign in now.
verifyEmail.error: Verification link is invalid or expired.

oidcCallback.title: Signing you in…
oidcCallback.subtitle: Hold tight while we finish authenticating your account.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

server.label: Server
server.httpsOnly: The app connects to HTTPS servers only. Use your server's https:// address.

communityLogin.title: Sign in
communityLogin.subtitle: Sign in to continue to this community.
communityLogin.noProviders: This community's sign-in isn't available. Check the link, or contact your community admin.
communityLogin.nativeUnsupported: Community sign-in isn't available in the app yet. Use a browser to sign in.

stepUp.title: Additional sign-in required
stepUp.description: This community requires signing in with {{providerName}} to access its content.

chooseHandle.title: Choose your username
chooseHandle.subtitle: Your account was given one automatically. Pick the name people will see.
chooseHandle.error: That username could not be set. Try another.

confirmAge.title: How old are you?
confirmAge.privacyNote: We keep your date of birth encrypted and use it only to check age limits. We don't sell your data.
confirmAge.scopeNote: Some communities and plug-ins have a minimum age, so we ask once. You won't be asked again.
confirmAge.required: Enter your date of birth to continue.
confirmAge.error: That could not be saved. Please try again.
confirmAge.blockedTitle: You told us you're not old enough yet
confirmAge.blockedBody: Communities anyone here can find need you to be 16 or older, so you can't join one for now. Everything in the communities you were invited to is unaffected.
confirmAge.blockedHelp: If you entered the wrong date, ask whoever runs this server to reset the question for you.

secondFactor.title: One more step
secondFactor.subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved.

factorStepUp.title: One more step for this community
factorStepUp.description: This community asks everyone for a second factor. Enter the code from your authenticator app to carry on.
factorStepUp.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved.
factorStepUp.notEnrolled: This community asks everyone for a second factor, and this account doesn't have one yet. Set one up in your security settings, then come back.
factorStepUp.error: We couldn't add your authenticator to this session. Try again.
factorStepUp.passkeyTitle: One more step for this community
factorStepUp.passkeyDescription: This community asks everyone for a passkey. Present yours to carry on.
factorStepUp.passkeyNone: This community asks everyone for a passkey, and this account doesn't have one yet. Add one in your security settings, then come back.
factorStepUp.passkeyNative: This community asks for a passkey, which the app can't present. Open it in a browser instead.
factorStepUp.proofNative: This change needs a fresh sign-in, which the app can't do here. Open the site in a browser instead.
factorStepUp.passkeyError: We couldn't add your passkey to this session. Try again.
factorStepUp.proofDescription: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Present your passkey, then try again.
factorStepUp.proofSignIn: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out and back in, then try again.
factorStepUp.proofEmail: This change needs a fresh sign-in. We can email you a code to confirm it's you, then try again.
factorStepUp.emailCodeSent: We sent a code to your email. Enter it to confirm it's you, then try the change again.
factorStepUp.emailCodeError: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
factorStepUp.platformDescription: This server requires a second factor. Enter a code from your authenticator app to carry on.
factorStepUp.platformNotEnrolled: This server requires a second factor and your account doesn't have one yet. Set one up to carry on — it takes about a minute.

emailOtp.title: Sign in with a code
emailOtp.subtitle: We'll email you a code to type in here.
emailOtp.captchaRequired: Please complete the captcha to continue.
emailOtp.codeSubtitle: We sent a code to {{email}}. It works for 10 minutes.
emailOtp.handleSubtitle: Your address is confirmed. Pick a name and you're in.
emailOtp.sendError: Could not send a code. Try again.
emailOtp.codeError: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
emailOtp.registerError: Could not create the account. Try again.

timeOut.title: Your account is suspended
timeOut.description: You can’t open any community or change anything until the suspension is lifted. Nothing has been removed — it will all be here when it is.
timeOut.contactNobody: Contact whoever runs this server about it.
timeOut.appealDescription: Tell the moderators why it should be lifted. They can write back to you here.
timeOut.appealSent: Sent. You can follow it here.
timeOut.appealError: Could not send your appeal. Try again in a moment.

captcha.loadFailed: The captcha couldn't load. Refresh the page to try again.
captcha.timeout: The captcha didn't load in time. Refresh the page.

choose.title: What brings you here?
choose.description: Hi, I'm Yonder, and I'll be getting things ready for you. Pick whichever fits best, since you can always do the others later.
choose.inviteHint: Join the community that sent it.
choose.inviteExample: The link your coach dropped in the team group chat.
choose.joinHint: Find a community anyone here can join.
choose.joinExample: A tabletop group that needs a fifth player, or people who love the same shows you do.
choose.personalHint: A place for your own to-dos.
choose.personalExample: Groceries and that car registration you keep putting off.
choose.sharedHint: A community for your team, friends or club.
choose.sharedExample: Your rec league soccer team or the book club.

invite.title: Your invite
invite.description: Paste the code or link you were sent and I'll check where it goes.

interest.title: What are you into?
interest.description: Pick as many as you like and I'll open the directory on those. If nothing here fits, skip this and you'll see everything.
interest.whereHint: Communities near you show up first. Nothing is hidden, so skip this if you'd rather not say.

you.title: About you
you.description: Pick a handle, which is how people find and mention you. Tap one of my ideas if you'd rather not think too hard about it.

personal.title: Your space
personal.description: Nobody else can see this space unless you invite them. I already filled in the names, so you can just hit Continue if they look fine to you.

shared.title: Your community
shared.description: You can change all of this later, so there isn't really a wrong answer here.
shared.initiativeHint: An initiative holds one area of work, like a team or an event. You can add more later.

plan.title: Choose a plan
plan.description: You can change it later in the community's settings.

account.title: Create your account
account.description: This is the last step, and it's how you'll sign in from now on.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in here and we'll finish setting things up.
checkEmail.approvalDescription: Whoever runs this server approves new accounts. Once yours is approved, sign in here and we'll finish setting things up.
checkEmail.planLater: You can choose a plan in the community's settings once you've signed in.

start.underAge: Communities anyone here can find are for people 16 and older, so the directory isn't open to you. You can still join a community you're invited to.

people.title: Invite your people
people.description: Send this link to anyone you want in {{community}}.
people.linkError: We couldn't make an invite link. You can make one in the community's settings.

start.starterError: Your community is ready, but its first initiative couldn't be made. You can add one from the community's home page.

notMe.title: Wasn't you?
notMe.description: We emailed you about a change to {{subject}}. If you didn't make it, sign your account out everywhere.
notMe.whatHappens: Signing out everywhere ends your account's sessions on every browser, phone and computer, and turns off its API keys. On its own it changes nothing else.
notMe.doneBody: Sign in again, then check your addresses, passkeys and two-factor authentication under Security. If you can't sign in, reset your password.
notMe.invalidBody: It has expired or been used already. If you're worried about your account, sign in and check your security settings, or reset your password.
notMe.failed: Your account couldn't be signed out. Try again.
notMe.undoConfirm: Undo it and sign out everywhere
notMe.cancelConfirm: Cancel it and sign out everywhere
notMe.undoneTitle: Undone, and you're signed out everywhere
notMe.cancelledTitle: Cancelled, and you're signed out everywhere

undo.proved: You can undo it: {{subject}} is removed from your account.
undo.primary: You can undo it: {{subject}} becomes your primary address again.
undo.removed: You can undo it: {{subject}} goes back on your account as its primary address, and the addresses added after it are removed.
undo.passkey: You can undo it: the passkey {{subject}} is removed.
undo.hold: You can cancel it, so it never happens.

notMe.told: The people who run this server have been told, and will look into it.
notMe.tellThem: Tell the people who run this server too: {{contact}}

demo.title: Try the demo
demo.description: You get a copy of your own to try things in. Nobody else sees what you change, and it deletes itself when the time is up.
demo.failed: The demo didn't start. Try again in a moment.

banner.message: This is a demo copy of {{community}}. It's deleted in {{remaining}}.
